title: Just OK
text: Just OK. In my opinion, these are over-priced for the quality and quantity received.  Keep in mind that you receive 8 containers, which have lids, this is how they calculate '16 pieces.'  Sizes are small and seem a bit light-weight as far as I am concerned.  Won't order again!
